profile.headline: Software Developer | Graduate of Turing School of Software & Design
profile.summary:
I am a software developer determined to do highest quality work in the most effective way. I graduated at Turing School of Software & Design for the backend program and earned my accredited backend software engineering certificate.

I have spent the last several years working in retail and some experience with The US Army. This experience helps me approach software development with keeping an attention to detail and double checking that I am providing high quality code.

I am currently learning ruby, have little experience with python, little experience with html, and some experience with javascript.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Develop backend services and APIs using C#, .NET, Entity Framework Core, and PostgreSQL.
 
 Build and maintain scalable application features, including user account management, notification infrastructure, and personalized user experiences. 
 
 Design and implement RESTful APIs while integrating PostgreSQL databases and following modern software architecture principles. 
 
 Collaborate with engineers through GitHub pull requests, code reviews, and Agile development workflows. 
 
 Troubleshoot complex build, dependency, and integration issues across multiple interconnected projects. 
 
 Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code while participating in architecture discussions and feature planning. 
 
 Work across multiple technologies including .NET, PostgreSQL, Firebase, Git, GitHub, and cloud based development tools.

Leveraged AI-assisted development tools, including Claude, to accelerate feature development, troubleshoot issues, and improve development efficiency while maintaining code quality.

positions.title: Benefits Advisor / Licensed Insurance Agent
positions.description:
Conduct inbound consultations to help Medicare beneficiaries evaluate Medicare Advantage, Prescription Drug (Part D), and Medicare Supplement coverage options. 

 Analyze healthcare needs, provider preferences, prescription coverage, and budget considerations to recommend suitable insurance solutions. 

 Explain plan benefits, costs, enrollment requirements, and coverage details while maintaining strict compliance with CMS, HIPAA, carrier, and company regulations. 

 Process insurance enrollments accurately and maintain complete documentation in accordance with Medicare and carrier requirements. 

 Build trust with clients by answering complex Medicare questions and resolving concerns through clear, empathetic communication. 

 Utilize CRM platforms and multiple software systems to manage customer interactions, policy information, and enrollment activities. 

 Consistently provide high-quality customer service while working in a fast-paced, compliance-driven environment.

positions.title: Sales Associate, Shift-lead, and Wellness Ambassador
positions.description:
Assisted customers in selecting consumer technology products by identifying their needs, explaining product features, and providing personalized recommendations. 
 
 Delivered technical guidance and troubleshooting support to help customers resolve product questions and improve their overall experience. 
 
 Served as a Shift Lead by coaching team members, providing operational guidance, and helping the team achieve sales and performance goals. 
 
 Supported daily retail operations through inventory organization, merchandising, stock replenishment, and maintaining an organized sales floor. 
 
 Assisted employees with HR-related questions, workplace resources, and employee benefit information while serving as a Wellness Ambassador. 
 
 Maintained strong performance metrics, excellent attendance, and a customer-focused approach while contributing to overall store success.
positions.insights: Customer Service, Consumer Electronics and +6 skills

positions.title: Front Desk Administrator
positions.description:
Delivered exceptional customer service by assisting residents, guests, and prospective clients with inquiries and requests. 
 
 Managed daily front desk operations, including answering multi-line phones, responding to emails, greeting visitors, and directing requests to the appropriate departments. 
 
 Coordinated communication between property managers, developers, vendors, and residents to ensure timely resolution of maintenance requests and operational matters. 
 
 Maintained accurate records, completed administrative documentation, and supported day-to-day office operations. 
 
 Scheduled and tracked service requests while ensuring clear communication and follow-up with all parties involved. 
 
 Fostered a welcoming, professional environment while handling multiple priorities in a fast-paced residential setting.

Conducted routine security patrols throughout residential buildings, parking garages, and surrounding property to help maintain a safe and secure environment. 
 
 Monitored security camera systems and reported suspicious activity or safety concerns in accordance with company procedures.

Controlled building access by verifying resident, guest, and vendor authorization, ensuring only authorized individuals entered the property.

projects.title: Heat Check
projects.description:
Heat Check is an app that helps spicy food lovers to explore restaurants that have an appropriate spice level to match. It allows users to search for restaurants with spicy dishes, add new dishes, review them, and rate their spiciness level.
● Project description: Utilized rails and GraphQL to create readable tests and methods that follow TDD
● Utilized agile workflow to outline code architecture and functionality at a high level through test driven development
● Technologies Used: Rails, TDD, GitHub, Heroku, Postman, GraphQL, CircleCI

projects.title: Little Esty Shop
projects.description:
Little Esty Shop is a program that simulates a website that shows the user all the data on the shops as well as their items. It also utilizes an API in order to calculate discount data based off of holidays.
● Project description: Utilized Ruby to fabricate readable code that follows TDD.
● Utilized daily standups and agile workflow to plan what needs to be accomplished by the end of the day
● Technologies Used:Ruby, TDD, GitHub, RSpec, OOP
